headline: A 1999 executive order directing federal efforts to develop and promote products and energy made from plants and other biological materials.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to encourage the development and wider use of biobased products and bioenergy. These are goods and fuels made from crops, trees, and other plant or farm materials instead of oil or coal. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, programs, or agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to take part in developing and promoting biobased products and bioenergy, though the exact duties are not stated in the title.
They may be affected as possible suppliers of the plant materials used to make these products and fuels.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that make biobased products or bioenergy
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by federal efforts to promote their industry.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 12, 1999; no separate start date is given in the available information.
